headline: Trump order names TikTok as a national security threat under an existing national emergency over technology supply chains.
what_it_does: This executive order targets the TikTok app as a threat to the United States. It builds on an earlier national emergency about risks in the supply chain for information and communications technology and services. Its title says it takes more steps under that emergency, but the material provided does not describe those steps.

who_it_affects.how: The order singles out TikTok as a national security threat, which can lead to federal limits on the company.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses in the US who use or deal with TikTok
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by any federal limits placed on TikTok, though the details are not given in the material provided.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 6, 2020; specific effective dates are not stated in the material provided.
